subject: Cristiano Ronaldo
title: 985 goals and still getting rested

lines.vo: Nine hundred and eighty-five goals, and still rested for a six-two win.
On November second he sat out a six-two Champions League win. Al Nassr scored six without him. Rotation, apparently.
lines.footage: Pakhtakor v Al Nassr Champions League highlights

lines.vo: Then he retired from Portugal. Twenty-three years, two hundred thirty-four caps, one hundred forty-six goals. That is a very long shift.
Portugal's first game without him: four-one to Denmark. The banner said thank you, captain. The scoreboard said, we noticed.
lines.footage: Portugal fans thank you captain banner

lines.vo: Fifteen short of a thousand. That is five hat-tricks. No man has ever reached a thousand.
So he is rested and ready for Al Ahli away. Al Ahli, you have been warned.
lines.footage: Al Nassr match day warm-up clip

inserts.story: A cartoon coach hands a caricature of Ronaldo a fluffy pillow and a sign saying Rotation. Gag: Ronaldo lies on the bench with eyes wide open, doing sit-ups on the pillow. Twist: a far-away whistle blows and he springs up already in full kit.

inserts.story: A cartoon Al Ahli coach builds a wall against a caricature of Ronaldo's free kick: ten tiny defenders with umbrellas. Gag: nobody looks at the ball, they all look at the sky. Twist: the wall is really stacked water bottles, a nod to the water plant he backs.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon coach and defenders; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

inserts.story: Cartoon fans hold a giant banner reading Thank you, captain. A caricature of Ronaldo hands his shirt and armband to a cartoon kit man, who stamps them Returned. Twist: the scoreboard behind them flashes 4-1 and the kit man quietly hands the armband back.
